summary: An intuitive hunch or creative idea becomes much easier to trust the second you find one practical way to act on it.
body: An intuitive hunch or creative idea becomes much easier to trust the second you find one practical way to act on it. When the Sun sextiles Neptune, conscious purpose and imagination cooperate, turning floating inspiration into something immediately useful. Write the first page, make the sketch, or give a daydream an hour of actual focus to see what happens when it survives outside your head. You do not need a flawless business plan to test whether an idea has merit. Build a low-stakes prototype, put it into the real world, and let the results dictate your next investment of time.
